subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

- Scope: AcmeHealth evaluating Redwood for clinical triage API (production integration pilot Q3). You flagged PHI handling and SOC 2 / BAA as primary items.
- Immediate ask: We will initiate the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire and share an initial set of answers plus our SOC 2 summary.
- Proposed timeline: initial answers + initiation form by end of day Tue (48 business hours), full SIG back within ~7 business days depending on clarifying questions.

Questions we had on the call that would help prioritize our responses:
1) Can you confirm whether the pilot will involve PHI at launch, or only de-identified clinical data?
2) Do you require a SOC 2 Type II report for procurement, or is a SOC 2 summary acceptable to start technical evaluation?
3) Any specific custom controls or attestations (e.g., penetration test report, HIPAA BAAs) required up front?

Attachments: [Attachment: SIG-Initiation-Form.xlsx (Excel, 45 KB)] — I’ve pre-filled the initiation form with the scope notes from today. Marissa (cc’d) will follow with our initial SIG answers and a SOC2 summary.

Next steps:
- Marissa: send initial SIG answers + SOC2 summary (ETA Tue EOD).
- Camila: follow up with timeline and any clarifying questions based on your response here.

Thanks again — we’ll move quickly on this.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
[Attachment: SIG-Initiation-Form.xlsx]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth

Camila — thanks for the recap and the initiation form. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot data: the initial pilot will include identifiable PHI (patient names, DOB, limited claims data) in a controlled environment. We will need BAA coverage for any environment where PHI is processed.
- SOC 2: Procurement will require a SOC 2 Type II report for vendor validation. For initial engineering review we can accept a SOC 2 summary, but procurement will need the full report under NDA before PO.
- Pen tests: we typically request the most recent external penetration test report (redacted if needed) as part of procurement.

Can you confirm whether Redwood: 1) will sign a standard BAA, and 2) can provide SOC 2 Type II report under NDA and a redacted pen test?

If possible, please route the SOC2 summary and any BAA draft to procurement@acmehealth.com and security@acmehealth.com. Sophie (cc’d) is our security lead and will coordinate.

Thanks — we’re looking to close vendor selection for the pilot by end of next week.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Procurement, AcmeHealth
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | (206) 555-4412

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks for the clarifications. Quick answers and what we can provide immediately: 

- BAA: Redwood will execute a standard BAA. I’ve attached a draft we typically use; we can accept minor procurement edits. [Attachment: BAA-draft.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in 2026. Full report is available under NDA; attached is a short SOC2 summary and scope document for your security review. [Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)]
- Pen test: We can share a redacted external penetration test executive summary under NDA.

Regarding PHI/hosting: we support PHI in Dedicated and Private deployments with contractual protections (BAA + dedicated capacity). For hosted API use cases we recommend Private deployment for PHI; if you prefer hosted, we can discuss contractual and technical compensating controls.

SIG status / timeline:
- I’ve started the SIG answers; attached are our initial responses to the initiation form and a partially completed SIG-Answers doc. We’ll aim to return a completed SIG within 7 business days but may have a few clarifying questions. [Attachment: SIG-Redwood-Initial-answers.pdf]

Next actions:
1) Alex / Sophie: confirm you’re ok receiving SOC 2 and pen test materials under NDA (we can send an NDA link or use your vendor portal).
2) If procurement wants a DocuSign BAA, send the envelope link and we’ll route to legal for signature.

If it helps, Camila and I are available for a short security sync this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
[Attachments: BAA-draft.pdf, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, SIG-Redwood-Initial-answers.pdf]
